### Today's Insight - July 9, 2012: The ABCs of Love
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/today-s-insight-july-9-2012.html
Passage: Proverbs 10:12
Points:
- True love accepts others, recognizes their value, shares their pain, seeks their good, and pardons offenses.
- Authentic love is never superficial and does not magically make relational difficulties disappear without effort.
- Godly love demonstrates tough resilience and staying power even when circumstances become turbulent.
- While the surrounding culture easily defaults to conflict and division, real love refuses to quit and stands firm.
